newsitem.title: USA: Ford to idle 2 plants next week.
newsitem.headline: Ford to idle 2 plants next week.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Thursday it will suspend production at its Lorain Assembly and Ohio Assembly plants next week.

The shutdown of the Lorain facility, which normally makes 3,200 Ford Thunderbird and Mercury Cougar coupes a week, will affect 1,450 hourly workers. About 1,750 hourly workers will be idled as a result of the Ohio shutdown. Ohio Assembly typically makes 2,900 Mercury Villagers and Nissan Motor Co Ltd Quest minivans.
Ford said several truck plants are working overtime this week, including St. Thomas, Ontario; Kansas City; Lorain truck; Kentucky Truck; Louisville; Norfolk; Oakville, Ontario; and St. Louis.
